d1_open.why: popularity-stratified: closed-book confidence varies smoothly with popularity, so mass spans the middle

d2_support.why: matched org-specific/general pairs: bimodal but overlapping

v1_like.why: the 50 v1 E3 beliefs, saturated; shows the v1 regime

notes: c2_prefix_noise_logit_sd sets how much less informative the prefix belief is than the final one; it is reported as the implied prefix-vs-final AUC and must be replaced by the E1-v2 dev prefix curve before freezing.
call_median for faiss is the v1 measured median retrieval duration (672 ms).
prefill_penalty is the v1 measured TTFA increment of retrieval at sentence_end (1.566 s) minus the 672 ms call: the part of retrieval's latency that overlap cannot hide.
faiss_rerank / remote_api medians, speech durations and the predictor error are PLACEHOLDERS to be replaced by dev measurements before freezing (PREREG_V2 section 5.4).
